Privacy
How we handle the details you give us.




Who we are


This site is run by The Audio Box, a home recording studio run by Cubs. If you have any questions about your details, message us on Instagram @theaudiobox_.


What we collect


Join form: your name, what you create, where you are based, what you are here for, a link to your work and your email address. Studio booking: your name, phone number or WhatsApp, optional email, the session you want and any notes. The booking form doesn't send anything to us by itself. It writes a message that you send from your own phone, so we receive what you choose to send.


Why we collect it


To review join requests, to contact you about your request, and to arrange and confirm studio sessions. We don't sell your details or use them for anything unrelated.


Visit counts


The footer shows how many people have visited the site, read the blog or sent a studio enquiry, and how many are on the site right now. These are simple totals. They use a random code that only lasts for your visit, so they don't say who you are.


Where it is kept


Join form answers are saved in a private Google Sheet that only we can open. Google provides that service, so your details are stored on their systems.


How long we keep it


Only for as long as we need it for the reasons above. You can ask us to delete your details at any time.


Your rights


You can ask to see what we hold about you, to correct it or to have it deleted. Contact us using the details above. If you are unhappy with how your details have been handled, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
